full_judgment: 9. The case of the petitioner in Writ Petition 6680 of 2001, in brief, is that the respondent No. 3 by SRO No. 677 / Ain/2001 dated 22-3-2000 has declared the area of Bauphal Pourashava including the areas of Mouza Bauphal JL No. 87 plot Nos. 10-44, 47-230, 234-382, 730-909, 911-916, 918-952, 954-1027, 1029-1430, 1436, 1448, 1808-1950, 2006 and Mouza Bilbilash JL No. 89 Plot Nos. 1258-1285, 1288-1484, 1548-1550, 1562, 1564 within the area of No. 12 Bauphal Union Parishad, Bauphal, Patuakhali. The Government by SRO No. 177-Ain/2001 dated 2-7-2001 has declared the area of Bauphal Pourashava under section 4(2) of the Pourashava Ordinance, 1977 with effect from 10-7-2001 which was communicated to respondent No. 4 vide Memo No. Poura-3/Ba-Bi/Gathan-13/99/811 dated 8-7-2001. The Government also appointed one Jiban Krishana Saha of village-Upazila Bauphal District Patuakhali as the Administrator of Bauphal Pourashava, Patuakhali. The respondent No. 4 vide Memo No. Sha-Ga-3- 17/2001-441 dated 3-9-2001 has divided the Bauphal Poura area and invited objection under rules 19, 21 and 21-A of the Pourashava Ordinance 1977. Subsequently, by notification dated 22-10-2001 the Government appointed Upazila Nirbahi Officer Bauphal as the Administrator of the Bauphal Pourashava. It is submitted that the total population in 9 wards of Bauphal Pourashava is 11,199 male and 5070 female which is not sufficient for formation of Pourashava and declaration of Bauphal Pourashava is contrary to the rules framed under the Pourashava Ordinance, 1977. It is further submitted that under section 3(2) of the Pourashava Ordinance, 1977 the Government shall not declare any rural area to be an urban area unless it is satisfied that three-fourth of the adult male population of the area to which it relates are chiefly employed in pursuits other than agriculture and such area contains not less than 15,000 population and an average of not less than 2,000 inhabitants per square mile. In the circumstances the formation and declaration of the Pourashava is illegal.
